title: Le Creuset – Enameled Cast Iron Sauté Pan with Pouring Spouts – Model No. 23
description:
Magnificent vintage sauté pan with lid by Le Creuset, crafted in high-quality enameled cast iron. Model No. 20, a rare and highly sought-after collector’s piece, combining practicality, durability, and timeless French design.
This model features integrated pouring spouts, designed to easily drain excess fat or liquids, making cooking healthier and more precise.
The cast iron construction ensures excellent heat retention and energy-efficient cooking, delivering optimal results while preserving the natural flavors of food.
Fully compatible with all heat sources, including induction, this versatile piece is also oven-safe thanks to its heat-resistant cast iron handle.
Equipped with a large main handle and an additional helper handle, it offers safe and easy handling, even when full.
Brand: Le Creuset
Model: No. 20
Material: enameled cast iron
Includes: sauté pan + lid
Features: pouring spouts, helper handle
Compatibility: all hobs, including induction + oven safe
Origin: Made in France
